answer: Vesting plus random audits: every reward vests over 30 epochs, and each epoch a VRF lantern picks 2% of seats for a live quiz by three peers. Farms that reuse one model's output betray themselves; even a whisper of shared phrasing links the cluster, and all its unvested pay is clawed back. At 100 POA per seat per epoch, a 200-seat farm has 600,000 POA at risk while about 4 of its seats are audited every epoch, so exposure is near-certain within a few epochs. The opal of payout only gleams after it has survived audit.
